ns2:course.label: Dev of Air and Space Power II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of AFAS 221. Historical survey of trends, events, and policies that led to the emergence of air power through Operation ALLIED FORCE. Also provides an introduction to basic leadership and management skills, ethical decision making, and basic communication skills. Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102. Prerequisite: AFAS 221 or consent of instructor.
